nodes.title: N3.1 k4 under-scaling: universal frozen table (zero cost, host -35..-39%) = deployable; cause = uncarried born fourth-order path content (certified), fix priced at 12 GEMM-eq/layer
nodes.claim: Measured against the 32M truth (teammate E, T-44): card v right to 0.3%, k3 3.5->11% off, k4 = 0.99, 0.84, 0.71, 0.61, 0.54, 0.47, 0.42, 0.38 x truth at L1/3/5/7/9/11/13/15 on r35, r100 identical within 0.03; residual after a per-layer rescale 12-29%. Mechanism (estimator_cap.py:1071-1130, _cp4_reset): the CP4 carrier is capped at rank 2048 by top energy (lambda^2 ||u||^8); unit-vector births have tiny energy and are dropped first; the cap binds from layer 3; the dropped terms' DIAGONAL is subtracted from the carried k4. The phase-1 two-vertex law (k4 from k3) fails here (best-c error 52-81%): k4 must be carried. Since forcing true (v, k3, k4) in-card reaches the noise floor (T-43) and each state alone moves ~40% of the residual at the final read, this is the largest priced single defect on record. Tests (teammate A, urgent): zero-cost rescale k4 := card_k4 / s_l with s_l fit on r35 and frozen to r100 (F2J off/on, independent scoring); then the derived orphan-diagonal carry (push the dropped diagonal, 1024^2/layer) or the CP4 cap ladder 2048 -> 4096 -> 8192 with its bill. T-45..T-48: raising the CP4 cap to 4096/8192 makes k4 slightly WORSE (the cap is not the cause; the review's mechanism attribution is retracted, the defect stands - the scale loss is in the CP4 physics itself). The under-scaling is universal across the 8-net panel (panel-mean ratio 0.986 -> 0.424 at L1..L14, sd 0.005-0.018; k4_ratio_panel_8M.json). Zero-cost frozen rescale k4 := card_k4 / s_l: host -37.5% (r35) / -29.8% (r100), 65-85% of exact-k4's host gain; truth k3+k4 on the card's own v beats the deployed full card by 25-39% F2J-off. Cause search (teammate A) in progress; derived fix preferred. T-49..T-51: cause found (the card's fourth-order planes lose ~half of the (3,1)/(2,2) content born each layer from the fourth-order distinct classes; k4 tracks K22; 4-path words are +121-134% of kappa4, 3-stars -4%); derived born-word plane feed certified (block patterns carry 33%/49% of the path contribution) and priced (12 GEMM-eq/layer, ~27% util) - stays as the physics behind the table. Canonical table public_g19_attribution_v1/k4_scale_panel.json (panel mean 0.986 -> 0.403); on its own host 5.27e-8 (r35) / 5.00e-8 (r100) F2J off. T-71: the same defect on the PLANES K22 (0.92 -> 0.41 of truth, corr 0.96-0.99) and K31 (0.52 -> 0.30); frozen plane scale tables explode the card (co-adapted quartic star) - replacement, not scaling.

ONE pattern carries it all: (0,1,0) = (1/2) K21pre[u,w] (-alpha_u pdf_u/sd_u) Phi(alpha_w) (sd_s Phi(alpha_s)) rho_us -> 2 GEMMs per read (deployable class); two-sided 1024^4 patterns are nil. Accumulated through the gate-only chain it reaches 55-60% of dk3 at depth but overshoots (slope 0.4-0.8): the card's real propagation of this content runs through the next planes/diagonal too. T-70 engine ablation (r35, per-unit k3 vs 32M truth): card 7.3/11.1% at L8/L14, engine with feed 4.4/7.3%, without 4.9/8.0% -> the feed is ~20% of the card->engine k3 gap in error points (its content is as large as the engine's whole residual, corr +0.5 with it). IN-CARD VALUE (T-69b/c, deployed operator untouched, independent 4M): k3 read alone r35 -10.2% / r100 -1.7% (3 GEMMs/layer, +4% util); full one-step plane read r35 -12.4% / r100 -2.7% at the physical scale (9 GEMMs/layer, +12% util); engine's exact accumulated feed content injected: r35 -9.1%. The v error (0.04% at L4 -> 0.26% at L14) is supply-driven: the one-step univariate variance map from truth pre cumulants is exact to 0.046% (= the truth's own noise); truth planes remove ~35% of it at depth (in-span channel); the rest comes from the unit-specific k3/k4 errors through the map (a 5% k3 error -> ~0.1% v). The half-v effect is 0-5% inside the operator's span (judge +0.41 / +0.43): v corrections are perpendicular whatever their source, but the channel punishes any component off the true direction as iid noise: the plane-corrected cards' v injected alone (corr 0.5-0.77 with the true dv) -> 2-3x WORSE; the full-tensor engine's dv-hat (corr 0.72-0.82) at half scale -7.7% (r35) / -4.9% (r100), at full scale +18%. Partial beats full (full truth v+k3: -36% / +37%): the operator co-adapts. Singles at half scale: v -25% / -35% / -24% (r35 / r100 / r150), k3 -32% / -5%. Supplies on record at half scale: the full-tensor engine's dv-hat + k3u shifts (corr 0.72-0.82 / 0.76-0.80) r35 2.073e-8 (-23%; k3 alone -11.8%, r100 k3 alone see T-80l); the truth-fourth-order + second-order engine's k3 shift (corr 0.85) -16.7%; the engine-K22-plane card's k3 shift (corr 0.74-0.79) -1.5%; ridge-from-tape dv (corr 0.25-0.45) WORSE. Value ~linear in alignment above ~0.7; off-direction components are punished as iid noise. Alignment levers (T-80k): fourth-order plane accuracy (card planes 0.2 -> engine planes 0.8; truth planes 0.835), the plane-to-distinct feed (+0.07), second-order Edgeworth (+0.02); the engine's ceiling with everything on record ~0.85. What is deployable today: engine-K22 planes + card K31 (k3 shift corr ~0.77, worth ~0). T-82..T-85b (Matt's bar: beat 2e-8 raw): the engine's shifts at half scale fail r100 (k3 +17%, dv+k3 +5%; alignment decays 0.82 -> 0.56 with depth); the engine-K22-plane card's shifts ~0 (early-layer alignment 0.25-0.7); partial plane fixes and partial k4 fixes with the operator collide (in-span). Truth skew planes through the linear pair consumer at half scale: 2.15e-8 / 2.06e-8 (needs ~3% skew planes in >= 32 directions; rank-8 keeps a quarter of the value); with the card's own fourth-order planes inside the consumer only -5.8%. No deployable supply meets the alignment bar. T-86..T-100d (score frame: adjusted = raw x util; a middling competitor is 1.854e-8 at util 0.218 = 4.04e-9): the engine's coherent under-scale table lifts skew alignment to 0.84-0.91; engine-class supplies in the self-consistent half-scale form reach r35 1.80e-8 but hurt r100 (oracle-assisted). The error is born LATE: exact per-unit (v,k3,k4) at L13-15 alone removes 49% of the F2J-off host error, L9-15 86%, L1-4 nothing; with the operator kept, half (v,k3) at L9-15 gives -52% (1.30e-8) and half v alone at L9-15 gives -20% / -29% on r35 / r100. The covariance residual at depth is low-rank and mean-aligned (top-eigen share 0.54-0.61, rank-16 0.81; |<u1,mu>| 0.8; diag of rank-16 E vs dv corr 0.90), Keenan's phase-1 structure - but writing the TRUE low-rank residual (full or diagonal, any scale or window) hurts or is neutral; only the exact per-unit v converts, and no computable direction carries a universal coefficient. A transported state corrector is dead (dv held-out 0.19 even with the oracle previous-layer error). Route left: a trained compensator write through a differentiable card (Keenan's converting mechanism), or a late-layer Tucker tensor engine.
nodes.criterion: Closed when a deployable (dv, dk3) supply graded at beta 0.5 with the operator ON cuts both nets by >= 20% (panel + virgin gate -> fire), or when the alignment ceiling of every GEMM-class supply is shown to be < 0.85.
